Graphite four-door sedan: Innerscene, CC0 1.0 Universal public-domain dedication.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Royal Oman Police emblem: official ROP header asset:
https://www.rop.gov.om/english/images/Logo.png
Copyright Royal Oman Police; NOT CC0. Their copyright notice reserves logo
reproduction permissions: https://www.rop.gov.om/english/copyright.aspx
Local educational police-vehicle depiction requested by the user. Public
redistribution permission has not been obtained. Preserve local-only status.

Police paint/response maps, door text and Arabic-only plate layouts: native
project-authored artwork. Noto Sans Arabic font: SIL OFL 1.1, see
../Fonts/Arabic/OFL.txt. English raster lettering uses Windows Arial Bold;
no Arial font binaries are redistributed.

The original car is separately user-supplied in SuppliedPoliceCar. This pack
does not replace or alter its mesh. OmanPoliceBadge.png is a rejected web
reference with a baked checkerboard background; it is not used in the scene.
